主要内容: Core Laboratories N.V. issued a press release on January 27, 2016, announcing its financial results for the fourth quarter of 2015 and the full year ended December 31, 2015. The press release is included as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K filing. The information in the report and the exhibit is not deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, nor is it incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, unless specifically stated. The press release provides details on the company's financial performance for the specified periods. The filing is signed by Richard L. Bergmark, the Chief Financial Officer of Core Laboratories N.V.
